svg.title: A100 PP2 rank component timelines
svg.desc: Static timelines for interleaved PP and original main, with one shared rail per rank and request-colored R0/R1 events.
svg.text: A100 Wan2.2 PP=2: rank-local component timeline
Two concurrent TI2V requests, 4 steps, eager PyTorch profiler. Bars use host spans for interleaved DiT and profiler annotations for Text/VAE.
Solid = CFG positive or non-CFG. White diagonal overlay = CFG negative / branch-enclosing only.
Shared rank rails: R0 = pp2-trace-0 (seed 42) and R1 = pp2-trace-1 (seed 43) use distinct request colors; component type is shown by outline.
R0/R1 share the same Rank row. Solid/diagonal fill distinguishes CFG positive/negative; outlines identify component.
R0/R1 share the same Rank row; profiler spans are request-ordered and the DiT bar encloses both CFG branches.
